name: Chemokine-guided monocyte trafficking via CCR2/CX3CR1 axis
rationale: All members concern chemokine/chemokine-receptor-directed leukocyte (mainly monocyte) chemotaxis and recruitment; the CCR2/CX3CR1 receptor modules and chemokine clusters set it apart from the inflammatory-monocyte-activation, lymphocyte/DC homing and integrin-adhesion confusables.

name: IRF3-mediated type I interferon induction by cytosolic DNA sensing
rationale: Members share IRF3-driven type I IFN and IP-10 induction in antiviral responses; cytosolic DNA sensing distinguishes it from the RIG-I/MDA5 dsRNA-sensing confusables.

core: Ryanodine-receptor ER calcium release and cytosolic Ca2+ removal
name: Ryanodine-receptor calcium release and cytosolic Ca2+ removal
rationale: All members regulate release of sequestered ER/SR calcium or its clearance from the cytosol; Na+/Ca2+ exchange, caffeine response and skeletal-muscle ryanodine control distinguish it from cardiac contraction and store-operated entry confusables.

core: Suppression of fatty acid uptake and beta-oxidation
name: Suppression of long-chain fatty acid uptake and beta-oxidation
rationale: All three members restrain fatty acid import or its oxidation, unlike confusables about lipid droplets/lipophagy, carnitine shuttle activation or adiponectin-glucose uptake.

name: Gastrulation, germ layer specification and left-right axis patterning
rationale: Members cover NODAL-regulated gastrulation, mesendoderm/endoderm formation, pluripotency exit and left/right asymmetry of gut and heart tube, distinguishing it from second-heart-field cardiogenesis and planar-cell-polarity convergent-extension confusables.

core: Dendritic spine remodelling and long-term synaptic plasticity
name: Dendritic spine remodelling and synaptic plasticity with reelin signalling
rationale: All members concern postsynaptic structure, dendrite/spine morphogenesis and LTP/LTD; reelin, LTP regulation, amyloid-beta and memory distinguish it from synapse assembly/adhesion and filopodium/RHO GTPase confusables.

qualifier: collagen GPVI and ADP P2Y receptors
name: Platelet activation via collagen GPVI and ADP receptors
rationale: Members share platelet adhesion, activation, aggregation and degranulation; GPVI/collagen, GPIb-IX-V and P2Y1/P2Y12 ADP signalling distinguish it from thrombin/thromboxane GPCR and VWF-variant confusables.

core: Innate receptor NF-kB and JNK/p38 activation
name: NOD1/2 and Toll-like receptor TAK1-driven NF-kB and JNK activation
rationale: Members are innate-sensor (NOD1/2, TLR-IRAK/TRIF, Dectin-1) cascades converging on TAK1/IKK to activate NF-kB and stress MAPKs; bacterial NOD sensing and TAK1-JNK/p38 output distinguish it from TNFR1/IKK-deficiency and negative-regulation confusables.

name: Osteoblast differentiation and ossification from mesenchymal progenitors
rationale: Members regulate mesenchymal stem cell and osteoblast proliferation/differentiation and ossification (RUNX2, Wnt, BMP); osteoblast focus distinguishes it from chondrocyte/joint and bone mineralization or collagen-secretion confusables.

core: CDK4/6-RB1 control of the G1/S transition
name: CDK4/6-RB1 G1/S restriction and p16INK4A senescence evasion
rationale: Members concern cyclin D/E-CDK, p27/p21 and RB1-E2F control of G1/S including defective p16INK4A-CDK4/6 binding; this distinguishes it from E2F target transcription, G2/M and p14ARF/TP53 confusables.

name: APC/C Cdc20-to-Cdh1 switch and late-mitotic substrate degradation
rationale: All members concern APC/C ubiquitin ligase activity during late mitosis/early G1, with the Cdh1 switch, Cdh1 autodegradation and Cdc6 removal distinguishing it from APC/C:Cdc20 metaphase-anaphase and Emi1 confusables.

name: Leloir pathway galactose catabolism and inherited galactosemias
rationale: All members are galactose catabolism via the Leloir pathway or its enzyme deficiencies, distinct from fructose, pentose and glucuronate metabolism confusables.

qualifier: destruction complex regulation and oncogenic mutants
name: Canonical Wnt/beta-catenin destruction complex regulation and oncogenic mutants
rationale: Members cover beta-catenin destruction-complex control, TCF/LEF target activation and repression and their cancer mutants or drugs, distinct from Notch, Wnt secretion and non-canonical Wnt/Ca2+ confusables.

core: NMDA receptor signalling in synaptic potentiation and memory
name: NMDA receptor-to-CREB signalling in synaptic potentiation and memory
rationale: Members concern NMDA receptor activation and downstream Ca2+-CaMK/AMPK/Ras signalling to CREB/NPAS4 in LTP and memory; postsynapse-to-nucleus CREB signalling distinguishes it from AMPA/kainate and spine-plasticity confusables.

name: pH-sensing channels and CFTR-dependent epithelial fluid transport
rationale: Members combine CFTR-linked anion and transepithelial water transport with acid/alkaline-sensing channels (TRP, TALK, sour taste); the pH-sensing arm distinguishes it from bicarbonate/SLC26 transporter and apical protein trafficking confusables.

name: Rab GTPase cycle and prenylation in vesicle docking
rationale: Members concern Rab/Arf GEF, GAP and geranylgeranylation control together with vesicle docking and SNARE assembly; the docking/SNARE component distinguishes it from Rho/Ral GTPase and Golgi tethering confusables.

name: Rac1 activation downstream of DCC and ephrin guidance receptors
rationale: The three members share guidance-receptor signalling to Rac1 (DCC attraction, ephrin), distinguishing it from ephrin repulsion, Slit-Robo and netrin repulsion confusables.

name: Glycinergic inhibitory transmission and locomotor behaviour
rationale: Members combine glycinergic transmission and hyperekplexia with locomotion, righting reflex and cerebellar development; glycinergic inhibition distinguishes it from exploratory/psychomotor behaviour confusables, and motor behaviour from the MECP2/GABA confusable.

name: RNA polymerase III transcription from type 1 and 2 promoters
rationale: All members are Pol III initiation, elongation or termination including tRNA transcription; type 1/2 promoter and tRNA focus distinguish it from snRNA type 3 promoter and Pol I rRNA confusables.

name: Bile acid synthesis from cholesterol and enterohepatic recycling
rationale: Members cover cholesterol-to-bile acid synthesis routes, bile acid transport, recycling and nuclear-receptor signalling, distinguishing it from intestinal lipid absorption, ABC transporter defects and peroxisomal oxidation confusables.

name: Vasopressin-aquaporin water reabsorption and glycerol/urea transport
rationale: Members share vasopressin-regulated, aquaporin-mediated water handling plus aquaporin glycerol/urea transport, which distinguishes it from renin-angiotensin and sodium/chloride osmoregulation confusables.

core: Histone methyltransferase and chromatin remodeller coregulators
name: Histone lysine/arginine methyltransferase and CHD-NuRD coregulator complexes
rationale: Members concern histone lysine/arginine methylation complexes (KMT2D/WDR5, PRMTs) and CHD/NuRD remodellers acting as transcription-factor cofactors, distinct from DNA methylation/PRC2 and HDAC/demethylase confusables.

name: Glutathione synthesis, gamma-glutamyl cycle and inherited defects
rationale: All members concern glutathione synthesis, recycling, transport or catabolism and their enzyme deficiencies, distinct from general amino acid and glutamate metabolism confusables.

core: Drug reward behaviour and neuropeptide signalling
name: Psychostimulant reward behaviour and opioid neuropeptide G-protein signalling
rationale: Members combine responses to cocaine, amphetamine and ethanol and reward conditioning with opioid/neuropeptide G-protein signalling; drug reward distinguishes it from social/sleep behaviour confusables and neuropeptide/opioid signalling from the dopamine receptor confusable.

core: Synaptic transmission and dendritic spine maintenance
name: Synaptic transmission, spine maintenance and sensorimotor gating
rationale: Members combine glutamatergic/GABAergic transmission, spine and postsynaptic maintenance and prepulse inhibition/nonassociative learning; the gating and transmission arms distinguish it from reelin plasticity, AMPA clustering and locomotor behaviour confusables.
